'''Mendor Typhoons''' was a [[Matukai/Legends|Matukai]], who had two apprentices c.[[580 BBY]]. He was approached by [[Bodo Baas]] after the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order's]] failed attempt to return the [[Zeison Sha]] into the Order's fold. Baas had heard that Mendor and his apprentices had defeated a group of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] on their own near [[Ord Radama/Legends|Ord Radama]].

He had a good sense of humor, but believed the Jedi's way of teaching students in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] was elitist and ineffectual, and believed he could do a better job of it.
